name: Champion Plastics
old_description: Champion Plastics, of Clifton NJ has been an industry leader in polyethylene packaging since 1972. We offer one of the largest selections of bags, liners, covers, films, sheeting, tubing and shrink packaging. Our 18 acre manufacturing facilities are state-of-the-art, with one of the largest resin storage silos in the industry holding a capacity of 2,000 tons of resin.
about:
Champion Plastics operates from an 18-acre campus in Clifton, New Jersey, where it has produced polyethylene packaging since 1972. The company remains a privately held manufacturer; no founders are named in public materials.

The facility houses one of the industry's largest resin storage silos, with a 2,000-ton capacity, feeding blown-film extrusion lines that produce bags, liners, covers, films, sheeting, tubing, and shrink packaging. Capabilities span custom sizes and gauges from 0.0005 to 0.010 mil, with configurations including gusseted, centerfold, perforated, and vented designs, plus printing up to ten colors. The plant supports FDA, EU, Kosher, and Halal compliant production and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

Customers span pharmaceutical, food, chemical, industrial, biohazard waste, waste removal, and retail sectors, along with a long list that includes aerospace, agriculture, automotive, construction, medical waste, and textiles. The company cites Fortune 500 firms among its long-standing accounts.

Champion emphasizes a service-first approach, citing broad product selection, competitive pricing, responsive service, and dependable delivery as the reasons customers stay. The business was built to make packaging one less variable in customers' operations.
